ABOUT M&M FIXINGS

Supplying construction
products since 1998.

We’re M&M Fixings, an independent supplier of fixings, power tools and construction products. Since 1998, we’ve helped the building trade across Cardiff and the surrounding area find the products they need.

Whether you know exactly what you’re after or need a little guidance, you’ll find a helpful team at our trade counter.
